verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an online service that holds taxpayer accounts, such as the eSystems/Webfile portal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents user-facing controls over retention or deletion. Changing contact information and closing business locations are account-maintenance actions, not data retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
